punchline: Twelve years of notes hid five complaints.
thirty_sec: To see why couples missed each other, Gary Chapman reread 12 years of his session notes and found the complaints fell into five groups. He tested the idea with couples and small groups first, and published the book in 1992.
question: Which pile of notes or conversations have you never read through in one go?
key_contrast: Separate troubles page by page, one pattern across the whole stack.
